messages.message: Allow user registration for any guest.
Use Google reCAPTCHA v2 to prevent spam registrations. In Google reCAPTCHA Admin, create a new key for the reCAPTCHA v2 "I'm not a robot" Checkbox and add this website's domains.
Enter the site key from a Google reCAPTCHA v2 "I'm not a robot" Checkbox key. v3 or legacy reCAPTCHA keys are not compatible with this checkbox.
Enter the secret key from the same Google reCAPTCHA v2 key pair. Keep it private; the server uses it to verify submissions.
If users must register their account at a different website, you can specify the URL to the registration form here.
